routes.title: Handcrafted Natural Mukhwas & Wellness | HIYAGHAR
routes.description: Discover handcrafted natural mukhwas, authentic Gujarati digestive treats, traditional tea masala, handmade soap, and artisan gifting from HIYAGHAR.
routes.intro: Authentic artisan digestives, royal chai spices & natural body care crafted with love.

routes.title: Premium Natural Mukhwas Collection | HIYAGHAR
routes.description: Shop HIYAGHAR premium mukhwas: handcrafted digestive mouth fresheners made from traditional family recipes with natural ingredients. See flavours and prices.

routes.title: Authentic Traditional Tea Masala | HIYAGHAR
routes.description: HIYAGHAR Tea Masala is an aromatic, authentic spice blend for making Indian chai at home. Choose your pack size, check the price and order online across India.

routes.title: Natural Handmade Cold Process Soaps | HIYAGHAR
routes.description: Browse HIYAGHAR handmade cold-process herbal soap bars, crafted in small batches with plant-based ingredients. Compare prices and offers, and order online.

routes.title: Ayurvedic Herbal Hair Oil | HIYAGHAR
routes.description: Shop HIYAGHAR Ayurvedic herbal hair oil for scalp nourishment, formulated with botanical extracts and handcrafted in small batches. Check price and order.

routes.title: Festive & Celebration Gift Hampers | HIYAGHAR
routes.description: Choose a HIYAGHAR gift by occasion: wedding, birthday, housewarming, festival or corporate. Curated handcrafted mukhwas, soaps and wellness gifts online.

routes.title: Customize Your Combo Pack | HIYAGHAR
routes.description: Build your own HIYAGHAR combo box: pick 3, 4 or 6 products from mukhwas, tea masala, handmade soap and hair oil, and save 10%, 15% or 20% on the bundle.
routes.intro: Select how many products you want in your bundle. Pick 3 items & save 10%, pick 4 items & save 15%, or pick 6 items & save 20%.

routes.title: Our Story & Heritage | HIYAGHAR
routes.description: Born in an Ahmedabad home kitchen, HIYAGHAR revives heritage family recipes for mukhwas and wellness products, slow-crafted in micro-batches with care.
routes.h1: Every Good Thing Has a Heartfelt Story.
routes.intro: At HIYAGHAR, we believe the purest culinary joys and digestive wellness come from authentic family traditions, slow-crafted methods, and 100% natural, honest ingredients.

routes.title: Contact Us | HIYAGHAR
routes.description: Contact HIYAGHAR by phone or WhatsApp on +91 9274443617 or email support@hiyaghar.com. Ask about orders, custom combo boxes, gift hampers or bulk orders.
routes.h1: We’d Love To Hear From You
routes.intro: Have questions about our handcrafted natural mukhwas, custom combo boxes, corporate gift hampers, or your delivery? We’re always here to assist you.

routes.title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) | HIYAGHAR
routes.description: Find answers to common questions about HIYAGHAR handcrafted natural mukhwas, tea masala, soaps, shipping, and custom gifting.
routes.intro: Everything you need to know about our handcrafted products, ingredients, shipping, and custom gifting.

routes.title: Privacy Policy | HIYAGHAR
routes.description: Read the HIYAGHAR privacy policy: what personal data we collect when you browse, register or order, how it is used and stored, and how we keep it safe.
routes.intro: This Privacy Policy describes in comprehensive detail how your personal data is collected, stored, processed, and safeguarded when you visit our website, register an account, or order handcrafted natural foods and wellness products.

routes.title: Terms & Conditions | HIYAGHAR
routes.description: The terms and conditions for browsing hiyaghar.com, creating an account and ordering HIYAGHAR products, including the natural variations of handcrafted goods.
routes.intro: By browsing, creating an account, or placing an order on hiyaghar.com, you agree to be bound by the following Terms and Conditions, which represent a binding agreement between you and Hiya Ghar.

routes.title: Refund & Cancellation Policy | HIYAGHAR
routes.description: HIYAGHAR refund and cancellation policy: cancel before dispatch for a full refund, and see how damaged or incorrect deliveries are replaced or refunded.
routes.intro: At Hiya Ghar, customer satisfaction and trust are at the heart of our kitchen. Because we craft natural food items, our return and refund policy is designed to be transparent, fair, and prompt.

routes.title: Shipping Policy | HIYAGHAR
routes.description: HIYAGHAR shipping policy: free standard delivery in India on orders of ₹500 or more, a flat ₹40 fee below that, ₹99 express where available, and timelines.
routes.intro: At Hiya Ghar, we treat every order like a fresh gift prepared with care. We partner with India’s top logistics providers including Blue Dart, Delhivery, DTDC, and India Post to deliver safe, tamper-evident packages across the nation.

routes.title: Track Your Order | HIYAGHAR
routes.description: Track your HIYAGHAR order: enter your order number to see its current shipping progress and courier updates, from dispatch through to delivery at your door.
routes.intro: Enter your Order Number above to view real-time shipping progress and courier updates.
